plan.title: Material PR to Auction PO Flow

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Commit the supported 30-minute event duration before publishing.
Invite two QA vendors without inventing supplier names, matching the two bidding vendors required.
Publish the configured event.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Submit the first vendor's quote through the vendor portal.
Verify the first vendor quote was accepted.
Submit a quote from a different vendor through the next vendor portal session.
Verify the second vendor quote was accepted.
Wait for bidding to end before inspecting rankings and awarding.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding closes.
Verify that the lower bid ranks first, covering the expected B-first ranking behavior without inventing vendor names.
Use the closest supported awarding flow, awarding to the lowest-ranked vendor; split allocation is not expressible.
Verify that an award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted proposal with the required approval remark.
Complete the supported PO creation flow after award approval.
Verify that the created purchase order carries the awarded PR line item and quantity.
Return to the events list to inspect the event's final list placement.
Open the History tab to check the post-completion event location.
Verify that this plan's event appears in event history.
